messages:
Jordan M: Hey team — quick sync on the Acme connector POC kickoff. They want to validate search + summarization over CRM + S3 docs. Propose kickoff agenda and success criteria before tomorrow's call.
Amy S: Can we get the list of customer stakeholders? who owns data access and who will run the evals? @Jordan M
Jordan M: Customer stakeholders: Emily (product), Raj (platform), Lila (security). They said they can provide a 10k doc subset and service account for S3 read-only.
Devon R: Good. For success criteria I suggest: 1) relevance precision@5 >= 0.75 on their eval set, 2) p50 generation latency <350ms for 512 tokens, 3) end-to-end cost estimate for typical requests < $0.015/token equivalent. Any objections?
Patrick O: precision@5 is fine. For latency we need to confirm model/quantization. Which model variant are we suggesting for Dedicated vs Hosted?
Devon R: Recommend redwood/rl-13b-quant (or equivalent 8-bit) for cost/latency balance. We'll produce baseline numbers in 48h using their sample to be conservative.
Sara L: Security questions: will secrets live in their KMS or ours? They asked about audit logs and HIPAA readiness. @security-bot can you list the minimal docs we need from them to complete the security questionnaire?
security-bot: Required items: 1) S3 bucket policy + read-only IAM role ARN, 2) data retention requirements, 3) whether PII will be included, 4) compliance modules requested (HIPAA/SOC2). Provide answers in this thread and we can pre-fill the questionnaire.
Amy S: Pricing: they asked for a capped POC rate and an estimate for scaling. We can offer POC credits for 4 weeks + pay-as-you-go for overage. I'll draft numbers after we see baseline token counts.
Jordan M: Discovery questions to ask on kickoff call: - typical query length and rate (QPS) - expected concurrency and top-k size - do they want embedding-only vs full RAG - example prompts and edge cases we should evaluate
Devon R: Also ask about connectors: are there custom parsers/attachments (pptx, emails), and whether the CRM exposes incremental change feed for near-real-time indexing.
Patrick O: For the eval harness I'll run a small script that outputs: precision@k, recall@k, MRR, latency histogram, token cost. Example snippet to show them:
```
# run eval
python eval_harness.py --docs s3://acme-poc/sample --queries queries.json --model rl-13b-quant --topk 5 --out results.json
```
Jordan M: Timeline I propose: Day 0-2 access + connector setup, Day 3-5 baseline runs + initial metrics, Day 6-10 tuning (prompts, index params), Day 11 demo + decision.
Amy S: Can we get a decision owner and acceptance criteria? Emily will likely sign off on product fit, Raj on performance/cost, Lila on security. Need explicit 'accept' thresholds written in the SOW.
Sara L: Action items: Amy to send provisional pricing, Devon to prepare eval harness + run baseline as soon as S3 access granted, Patrick to prepare runbook for connector setup, Jordan to schedule kickoff and invite Emily/Raj/Lila.
Jordan M: I'll schedule for tomorrow 10am PT and attach the sample agenda. Quick note: include 'what success looks like' slide so everyone aligns.
Amy S: I'll attach a short SOW template and POC pricing sheet in the meeting invite. :thumbsup:
Devon R: If they can't give a large sample, we can still run synthetic queries with masked docs — flagging realism tradeoffs.
Patrick O: Reminder: if they require on-prem/private deployment for POC, that becomes a separate track — raise immediately.
Jordan M: Great, thanks. I'll post meeting invite now and add follow-ups here.
